content.title: Game Day Central | Dallas Stars
content.text: Skip to Main Content Welcome to the ultimate Dallas Stars Game Day hub! From game-day parking to streaming every slapshot, we’ve got you covered. This season, the lads in Victory Green are hitting the ice for 41 home games at American Airlines Center and you won’t want to miss a single one. Are we on the road? No problem. Catch most away games for free on Victory+, the exclusive streaming service made just for Stars fans. Click here for the full broadcast schedule. You can also join fellow fans at local hotspots throughout the season for official Dallas Stars Watch Parties where raffles, exclusive memorabilia, and surprise giveaways await! Upcoming Games View Seats View Seats Previous Next Arena Information Arena ParkingOver 5,000 parking spaces are available for American Airlines Center guests. The majority of these parking spaces are located within two blocks of American Airlines Center. In addition, there are over 3,000 parking spaces to the South and East of American Airlines Center within easy walking distance. Parking lots open two hours prior to the start of each event and remain open until two hours after the end of each event. Overnight parking and “in and out” privileges are not permitted. Arena PoliciesBag Policies: Wristlet, clutch or wallet 4.5''x6.5'' are allowed. Purses no larger than 14''x14''x6'' are permitted at X-ray entry points. No backpack or large totes allowed. Medical bags and parenting bags are permitted. Cashless Payment: Guests can pay for items using valid debit or credit cards, or mobile wallets. Door Openings: Doors open 90 minutes prior to puck drop. For a full list of arena policies and FAQs, click here. Party on PNC PlazaTwo hours before the start of every home game fans will find activities for the whole family, including street hockey, a slapshot cage, corn hole and more. During the weekend and for special events fans can also enjoy live music, special performances, and unique offerings from local vendors. To stay up to date on the latest PNC Plaza information and updates, check back in here or follow us on social media. My 1st Game PuckBringing your kiddo to their very first game this season? Make it unforgettable! Stop by the Vic’s Kids Club table outside section 122/123 and pick up a “My 1st Game” puck, courtesy of Ideal Dental, to celebrate this special occasion. It’s the perfect keepsake for a day they’ll always remember. We’re thrilled to have you and your future fan at American Airlines Center. Go Stars! Where to Watch and Listen Victory+Victory+ is the first free end-to-end, direct to consumer, premium sports streaming service for professional teams. On Victory+ fans will be able to watch regional broadcasts of sports games and competitions, which will be available on an ongoing basis. This season, the Stars will broadcast 69 of the team’s 82 regular-season games on Victory+ along with 16 games being covered nationally on ESPN, ABC, TNT and ESPN+/Hulu. Color analyst Daryl “Razor” Reaugh and play-by-play announcer Josh Bogorad return as the broadcast duo for Stars television. Extended coverage before and after the games will be hosted by Brien Rea and former NHL player Brent Severyn. Victory+ will be accessible across North America with content available across regions. Your specific location will give you access to certain live games. Dallas Stars games will be available on Victory+ if you live in Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, or Arkansas. If you live outside of those states you will not be able to watch the live games however you will still have access to additional, on-demand, Dallas Stars content. The TicketSportsradio 96.7 FM and 1310 The Ticket has been the flagship radio home of Dallas Stars hockey since 2005 and will broadcast all 82 regular-season games. Catch the postgame show with Bruce Levine and Michael Dixon following each game all season long. During select games a bonus pregame show is available too!
